newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Airlines sets local ticket time limits.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Airlines sets local ticket time limits.

text.p: Malaysian Airline System Bhd said on Monday it is introducing new time limits for the purchase of local air tickets effective on July 21 in order to improve efficiencies in its reservation systems.
In a statement, the national carrier said confirmed bookings would be cancelled if passengers failed to buy the tickets by the new deadlines.
For a departure date of over 45 days from the date of the booking, passengers must pay for the ticket in 14 days from the date of the reservation.
The ticketing time limit falls to one day from the day of booking for a departure date between eight to two days from the reservation day.

MAS said that the new procedure is aimed at curbing "late cancellation of seats as well as no-shows by passengers, a perennial practice that has denied other genuine passengers from securing confirmed seats".
"With the introduction of this Ticketing Time Limit procedure, genuine passengers will be able to obtain confirmed seats at an earlier date," MAS added.
